items.title: George P. Fleming Interview, 1984-10-06
items.q: Alfred Williams and I played with Steve Lewis, piano player.

ctx.x: So you went out and you bought this trumpet in the pawn shop and how did you start? Did you take lessons or did you just figure it out yourself?

I just figured it out myself. And I was blowing around and I played with, during that time before I learned how to read, was playing with guys like Alfred Williams. And so Alfred Williams and I played with Steve Lewis, piano player. We played at the place, at the Saint-Sou Hall on Howard Street between Washington and 6. I played there with him and I was just, oh, I was about, oh, my teens, late teens at that time.
